title: Open Mic @ Jives Coffee Lounge
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring all acts in a welcoming coffee lounge atmosphere. Live music performances from local talent in Old Colorado City.
hosts: The Over-Prepared Open Mic hosted by Poet North Star
event_venue_information:
About Jives Coffee Lounge

Jives Coffee Lounge is a beloved Colorado Springs institution located in Old Colorado City. With the motto Coffee Music Life this cozy venue has been serving the community for years with specialty coffee drinks live music and a welcoming family atmosphere.

Music and Events

The venue hosts open mic nights every Wednesday from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM with signups starting at 5:30 PM. In addition to the weekly open mic Jives features live music performances on Friday and Saturday nights and Irish Pub Music on Thursday nights from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The eclectic quirky decor includes mismatched furniture a red piano and a guitar with Elvis photos creating a unique artistic environment.

Venue Features

Both indoor and outdoor seating options are available with a shaded patio perfect for Colorado weather. The venue is dog-friendly making it a popular spot for pet owners. Jives serves a variety of specialty drinks including the popular White Tiger Red Moon latte and spicy mocha along with sandwiches pastries and bagels.

title: Open Mic @ Vultures
event_description: Weekly open mic night for musicians and comedians in an intimate music venue setting. Sign ups begin at 6:00 PM and performances start around 7:00 PM.
venue_address: 2100 E Platte Ave Colorado Springs CO 80909
event_venue_information:
About Vultures

Vultures is Colorado Springs newest neighborhood bar and music venue located in the Knob Hill Arts District. This unique space combines the charm of a local dive bar with quality sound and lighting creating an intimate atmosphere perfect for experiencing live music.

Music Programming

The venue hosts Open Mic Night every Monday with signups at 6:00 PM and performances starting around 7:00 PM. Musicians and comedians are welcome. Throughout the week Vultures features live bands across multiple genres including rock indie punk and alternative. The venue has a capacity of 150 and is known for its excellent sound system and friendly staff.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The walls are decorated with old posters and knickknacks including quirky details like a tiny skateboard and disco ball. The venue serves drinks and comfort food with fair prices. All ages are welcome making it accessible to the entire community. Happy hour runs from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM daily.

title: Open Mic @ Kinfolks
event_description: Weekly open mic night at this craft beer venue in historic Manitou Springs featuring local musicians and performers.
event_venue_information:
About Kinfolks

Kinfolks is a specialty craft beer bar and music venue located in the heart of historic downtown Manitou Springs. The venue specializes in rotating craft beer selections from across the United States along with small batch bourbons whiskeys wine and savory meat pies from Mountain Pie Co.

Music Events

Every Wednesday night Kinfolks hosts an open mic starting at 7:30 PM hosted by Ramsey. The venue also showcases local and national musical acts on their stage throughout the week. The intimate setting creates a perfect atmosphere for both performers and audience members to enjoy quality music in a relaxed environment.

Venue Details

The venue is closed on Mondays and Sundays but open Tuesday through Saturday. They accept credit cards and reservations. The outdoor patio is dog-friendly. Kinfolks has become a favorite gathering spot for music lovers and craft beer enthusiasts in the Pikes Peak region.

title: Open Mic and Jam @ Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort
event_description: Acoustic open mic hosted by Black Rose Acoustic Society on 2nd and 4th Wednesdays followed by an open jam session until 9:00 PM.
venue_address: 2 El Paso Blvd Colorado Springs CO 80904
event_venue_information:
About Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort

The Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort is a unique 46-room boutique hotel originally opened as a hunting lodge in 1919. Located at the gateway between Old Colorado City and Manitou Springs the lodge offers a fleet of bikes for guests and features live music five nights a week Wednesday through Sunday.

Music Programming

The lodge hosts the Black Rose Acoustic Society Open Mic on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday of each month from 6:00 PM to 8:40 PM followed by an open jam until 9:00 PM. Performers can sign up starting at 5:30 PM for a 3-song set on a first-come first-served basis. Sunday afternoons feature the Colorado Springs Pickers Bluegrass Jam from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The venue also presents live concerts throughout the week featuring folk Americana and bluegrass artists.

Annual Events

The Buffalo Lodge hosts the BuffaloGrass Music Festival each October a three-day celebration featuring 16 bands across two stages with daily picking circles jam sessions yoga bike rides and local food trucks. The intimate log-cabin atmosphere provides excellent acoustics and a family-friendly environment.

title: Jazz Jam @ Armadillo Ranch
event_description: All-ages jazz jam session with professional rhythm section. Musicians prepare jazz standards and sit in with rotating hosts and professional players.
hosts: Rotating Jazz Musicians - Adam Gang Colin McAllister and others
event_venue_information:
About Armadillo Ranch

Armadillo Ranch is a historic bar restaurant and live music venue located in the heart of downtown Manitou Springs. The venue serves chef-prepared burgers sandwiches in-house smoked pork and wings with vegetarian vegan and gluten-free options available.

Music Programming

The venue presents live music five days a week featuring local and regional artists across multiple genres including rock jam funk bluegrass americana folk reggae and singer-songwriter. Monday nights feature Jazz Jam Sessions co-sponsored by the Pikes Peak Jazz and Swing Society and Tidal Breeze Jazz Arts. The jam runs from 7:00 PM to 9:30 PM with various jazz musicians hosting throughout the month including saxophonist Adam Gang and guitarist Colin McAllister.

Other Events

In addition to jazz jams the venue hosts trivia karaoke and drag brunches. A 3.50 dollar entertainment fee per person is added to tabs during live music shows to support the local artist community. The Armadillo Ranch has become a cornerstone of Manitou Springs music scene.

title: Black Rose Bluegrass Jams
event_description: Multiple bluegrass jam sessions throughout the month for beginning intermediate and advanced players in various locations. Festival-style jams with no written music.
venue_name: Beth-el Mennonite Church and other locations
hosts: Black Rose Acoustic Society Jam Leaders
event_venue_information:
About Black Rose Acoustic Society

For over 30 years the Black Rose Acoustic Society has been the home of live handmade acoustic music in the Pikes Peak Region. The organization hosts twice-monthly concerts at the Black Forest Community Center on second and fourth Fridays along with numerous jam sessions throughout the month.

Jam Sessions

The Black Rose offers multiple jam sessions in various genres. Festival Bluegrass Jams are held on the 1st and 3rd Mondays at Beth-el Mennonite Church from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM emphasizing festival jam etiquette where musicians look at each other not at paper. Other jams include Beginning and Intermediate Bluegrass Pop and Rock from the 60s and beyond Fiddle Tunes Gospel Select Handpicked Jams featuring different songwriters and Gypsy Swing Django Reinhardt style.

Concerts and Community

The twice-monthly concerts at Black Forest Community Center feature outstanding national and regional musicians in an intimate log-cabin setting. The Black Rose Stomp a rousing sustained floor-shaking roar of approval is a beloved tradition when performers deliver exceptional music. All jam levels welcome from beginner to advanced.
